chunks: And We will drive the criminals to Hell in a drove.
ai.seo_question: How are the sinners described as being driven to Hell in Surah Maryam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'wirda' (drinking at the watering hole) highlights the humiliating, herd-like compulsion of the sinners, contrasting their forced march with the voluntary approach of the righteous to Paradise. This imagery underscores the divine justice where the guilty are driven by their own accumulated deeds, serving as a vivid warning for believers to maintain taqwa (God-consciousness) in their daily conduct.
